routing.review_scope: a design (schematic, board, CAD part, firmware)

hw-lead.title: Hardware lead
hw-lead.description: Hardware lead. Turns a product idea into requirements and an architecture, chooses the key parts, splits the work into tasks for the hardware specialists and checks the result. Talk to this one.

hw-research.title: Component researcher
hw-research.description: Component and datasheet research - finds parts that meet a spec, reads datasheets and application notes, extracts pinouts, ratings and reference circuits with page references.

hw-schematic.title: Schematic engineer
hw-schematic.description: Electronics design - circuit design and KiCad schematics from a spec and part list, with a clean ERC. Decoupling, protection, connectors, power tree.

hw-layout.title: PCB layout engineer
hw-layout.description: PCB layout in KiCad - board outline, placement, routing, ground pours, with a clean DRC and renders. Exports Gerbers.

hw-mech.title: Mechanical engineer
hw-mech.description: Mechanical CAD in FreeCAD - enclosures, brackets, mounts and fixtures that fit the board, verified by measurement, exported as STEP and STL.

hw-review.title: Design reviewer
hw-review.description: Independent design review - re-runs ERC/DRC and measurements, checks schematics against datasheets and boards against the schematic and the mechanics. Approves or returns work with concrete fixes.

hw-docs.title: Documentation and release
hw-docs.description: Documentation and release files - BOM, assembly notes, pinout tables, README, and the manufacturing package (Gerbers, position file, STEP) collected in one folder. Cheapest.
